verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent and trade mark office offering databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and filing services, so an official MCP server for agent access is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence covers only web portals, filing software and paper or fax routes, with no mention of an MCP server or any agent-facing interface. The robots.txt probe, which disallows crawling of the register host, is not evidence of an MCP server.
